name: Cilantro Lime Rice
steps: Warm the oil in a saucepan and stir the rinsed rice in it for about a minute, until it smells toasty.
Add the water and salt, bring to a boil, then cover and turn the heat to low for 15 minutes.
Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 5 more minutes.
Fluff with a fork and fold in the lime zest, lime juice and cilantro.
To reheat, sprinkle with a spoon of water, cover and microwave until steaming.

name: Crispy Garlic Roasted Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the potatoes with the oil, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper right on a sheet pan.
Turn them cut side down and roast 30-35 minutes, flipping once, until crisp and golden.
Reheat in a hot oven or air fryer for a few minutes so they crisp up again.

name: Cold Sesame Ginger Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the package says, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar, honey and ginger in a big bowl.
Toss the noodles in the sauce and top with green onions and sesame seeds.
Eat cold or at room temperature. Toss again before serving; they soak up sauce as they sit.

name: Lemon Herb Orzo
steps: Boil the orzo in well-salted water until just tender, about 9 minutes, then drain.
While it's still hot, stir in the butter, lemon zest and lemon juice.
Fold in the parsley and dill and taste for salt.
Reheat with a splash of water so it loosens up again.

name: Creamy Parmesan Polenta
steps: Bring the water and salt to a boil, then pour in the polenta slowly while whisking.
Turn the heat to low and cook 25-30 minutes, stirring every few minutes so it doesn't stick.
Stir in the parmesan and butter just before serving.
It firms up in the fridge: reheat with a splash of milk or water, whisking until creamy, or slice and pan-fry.

name: Roasted Broccoli with Parmesan and Lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Spread the broccoli on a sheet pan, toss with the oil, garlic and salt, and keep it in one layer.
Roast 18-20 minutes until the edges are browned.
Squeeze the lemon over it and scatter the parmesan on top while it's hot.

name: Garlicky Green Beans
steps: Boil the green beans in salted water for 3 minutes, then drain.
Melt the butter with the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beans and cook 4-5 minutes, tossing, until they have a few blistered spots.
Stir in the garlic for the last minute so it doesn't burn, then season.

name: Honey Butter Glazed Carrots
steps: Put the carrots, water, butter and salt in a skillet, cover, and simmer 8 minutes.
Take the lid off, add the honey and keep cooking until the water is gone and the carrots are shiny.
Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

name: Charred Street Corn Skillet

ingredients.name: corn kernels (frozen and thawed is fine)

steps: Melt the butter in a large skillet over high heat.
Add the corn in one layer and leave it alone for 3-4 minutes so it chars, then stir and repeat.
Off the heat, stir in the mayonnaise, lime juice and chili powder.
Top with the cheese and cilantro.

name: Ginger Garlic Bok Choy
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or big skillet over high heat.
Add the bok choy cut side down and let it brown for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and a splash of water, cover, and steam 2 minutes until the stems are just tender.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil. Best eaten fresh.

name: Roasted Zucchini and Peppers with Oregano
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the vegetables with the oil, oregano and salt and spread them on a sheet pan.
Roast 25 minutes, stirring halfway, until soft with browned edges.
Splash with the vinegar before serving. Good warm or cold.

name: Greek Cucumber Tomato Salad
steps: Put the cucumber, tomatoes, onion and olives in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano and a pinch of salt, and pour it over.
Toss gently and top with the feta.
For meal prep, keep the dressing separate and add it the day you eat it.

name: Crunchy Asian Slaw
steps: Toss the cabbage, carrots, edamame and green onions in a large bowl.
Shake the vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and honey in a jar.
Pour over the slaw, toss, and top with the peanuts.
Cabbage stays crunchy for days; keep the peanuts separate so they don't go soft.

name: Black Bean and Corn Salad
steps: Mix the beans, corn, bell pepper, onion, jalapeno and cilantro in a bowl.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and a big pinch of salt and pour over.
Stir well and let it sit 15 minutes so the flavors soak in.
It tastes even better on day two.

name: Arugula Salad with Parmesan
steps: Put the arugula in a wide bowl.
Drizzle with the oil and lemon juice, season, and toss with your hands.
Top with the parmesan and serve right away (dressed greens wilt fast).

name: Smoky Stewed Pinto Beans
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, paprika and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the beans with their liquid and the water.
Simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few beans against the pot to thicken it.
Reheats perfectly; add a splash of water if it gets too thick.

name: Quick Pickled Cucumbers
steps: Stir the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved.
Pack the cucumbers in a jar, pour the vinegar mix over and add the pepper flakes.
Chill at least 30 minutes. They get tangier each day.
